## Summary

Closes out the core v2 build with the entry-point document: what v2 is for, how it differs from and relates to examples/keeper-bot, and how to get a first instance running.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] States plainly that v1 remains the recommended starting point for newcomers and contract exploration, and v2 is for operators running competitively.
- [ ] A minimal quickstart gets a reader from zero to a running dry-run instance (issue 0264) using only this document.
- [ ] Links to the migration guide (issue 0275) for existing v1 operators, and to the full design doc (issue 0250) for anyone wanting the reasoning rather than just the how.
